name: Vélez-Rubio (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Vélez-Rubio (trees on yellow above waves).
history: The flag used by the municipality is described as a rectangular crimson flag crossed by a green diagonal band from the upper left corner to the lower right.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
